== Story 615: source-checked comparison ==

[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), p. 44. The revised game-text paragraph is separate from subsequent rulings; the glossary legend is on p. 2. The shared comparison includes the complete game text and distinguishes the later face stamp from the date of the underlying text. Original publication month is left unspecified. No card or GEMP identifiers were allocated. The retained state at [[Dack Ralter (Errata)]] copies card data from [[Special:PermanentLink/319381|Dack Ralter (PC Errata), revision 319381]], with its established identifier 3_4 unchanged.
